tv_build_conquest_headquarters = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 12
	should_execute_price = no
	price = price:tv_io_headquarters_price

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_conquest_victory_enabled }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			tv_conquest_establishment_basic_done = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_conquest_victory_enabled }
			NOT = { tv_conquest_establishment_headquarters_done = yes }
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = location
		source = actor
		interaction_source_list = {
			scope:actor = {
				capital = { add_to_list = source }
			}
		}
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_select_conquest_headquarters_location"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_no_conquest_headquarters_location_available"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		column = { data = left_click_and_confirm_cost }
		visible = {
			owner ?= scope:actor
			is_capital = yes
		}
		enabled = {
			scope:actor = {
				tv_conquest_establishment_basic_done = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_conquest_victory_enabled }
			}
			tv_conquest_headquarters_can_build_in_location = yes
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				scope:actor = {
					tv_conquest_establishment_basic_done = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = tv_conquest_victory_enabled }
				}
				scope:target = { tv_conquest_headquarters_can_build_in_location = yes }
			}
			scope:target = {
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_conquest_headquarters }
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = { add = 50 }
}

	type = owncountry

	potential = {

			NOT = { has_variable = tv_conquest_victory_enabled }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = { tv_conquest_establishment_ready_to_appoint = yes }
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = character
		source = actor
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_select_grand_general"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_no_grand_general_available"
		column = { data = character_info }
		pre_evaluation_sort_value = {
			value = total_abilities
		}
		pre_evaluation_number_to_evaluate_fully = 1
		visible = {
			is_alive = yes
			is_adult = yes
			is_female = no
			is_artist = no
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_CHARACTER_NOT_ALREADY_TV_IO_CHIEF_TT
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_io_chief_role }
			}
			is_ruler = no
			is_heir = no
			is_consort = no
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				scope:actor = { tv_conquest_establishment_ready_to_appoint = yes }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				scope:actor = { tv_establish_conquest_io_effect = yes }
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = { add = 75 }
}

tv_build_trade_headquarters = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 12
	should_execute_price = no
	price = price:tv_io_headquarters_price

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_victory_enabled }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			tv_trade_establishment_basic_done = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_victory_enabled }
			NOT = { tv_trade_establishment_headquarters_done = yes }
			OR = {
				is_ai = no
				monthly_trade_income >= 100
			}
			OR = {
				is_ai = no
				any_country = {
					count < 10
					is_leader_of_international_organization_of_type = { type = tv_trade_league }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = location
		source = actor
		interaction_source_list = {
			scope:actor = {
				capital = { add_to_list = source }
			}
		}
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_select_trade_headquarters_location"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_no_trade_headquarters_location_available"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		column = { data = left_click_and_confirm_cost }
		visible = {
			owner ?= scope:actor
			is_capital = yes
		}
		enabled = {
			scope:actor = {
				tv_trade_establishment_basic_done = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_victory_enabled }
				OR = {
					is_ai = no
					monthly_trade_income >= 100
				}
				OR = {
					is_ai = no
					any_country = {
						count < 10
						is_leader_of_international_organization_of_type = { type = tv_trade_league }
					}
				}
			}
			tv_trade_headquarters_can_build_in_location = yes
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				scope:actor = {
					tv_trade_establishment_basic_done = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_victory_enabled }
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						monthly_trade_income >= 100
					}
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						any_country = {
							count < 10
							is_leader_of_international_organization_of_type = { type = tv_trade_league }
						}
					}
				}
				scope:target = { tv_trade_headquarters_can_build_in_location = yes }
			}
			scope:target = {
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_trade_headquarters }

tv_build_diplomatic_headquarters = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 12
	should_execute_price = no
	price = price:tv_io_headquarters_price

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_diplomatic_victory_enabled }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			tv_diplomatic_establishment_basic_done = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_diplomatic_victory_enabled }
			NOT = { tv_diplomatic_establishment_headquarters_done = yes }
			OR = {
				is_ai = no
				modifier:diplomatic_reputation >= 20
			}
			OR = {
				is_ai = no
				NOT = {
				  any_international_organization = {
				    international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_diplomatic_alliance
				    count >= 10
				  }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = location
		source = actor
		interaction_source_list = {
			scope:actor = {
				capital = { add_to_list = source }
			}
		}
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_select_diplomatic_headquarters_location"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_no_diplomatic_headquarters_location_available"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		column = { data = left_click_and_confirm_cost }
		visible = {
			owner ?= scope:actor
			is_capital = yes
		}
		enabled = {
			scope:actor = {
				tv_diplomatic_establishment_basic_done = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_diplomatic_victory_enabled }
				OR = {
					is_ai = no
					modifier:diplomatic_reputation >= 20
				}
				OR = {
					is_ai = no
					NOT = {
					  any_international_organization = {
					    international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_diplomatic_alliance
					    count >= 10
					  }
					}
				}
			}
			tv_diplomatic_headquarters_can_build_in_location = yes
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				scope:actor = {
					tv_diplomatic_establishment_basic_done = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = tv_diplomatic_victory_enabled }
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						modifier:diplomatic_reputation >= 20
					}
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						NOT = {
						  any_international_organization = {
						    international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_diplomatic_alliance
						    count >= 10
						  }
						}
					}
				}
				scope:target = { tv_diplomatic_headquarters_can_build_in_location = yes }
			}
			scope:target = {

			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_academy_of_sciences
			leader_country ?= scope:actor

				text = TV_CHARACTER_NOT_ALREADY_TV_IO_CHIEF_TT

# Arts Exhibition (non-unique IO)
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

tv_appoint_arts_leader = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 99999

	potential = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_ARTS_EXHIBITION_MEMBER_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_arts_exhibition_member }
		}
	}

	allow = { always = yes }

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = character
		source = actor
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_select_arts_leader"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_no_arts_leader_available"
		column = { data = character_artist }
		visible = {
			is_alive = yes
			is_adult = yes
			is_artist = yes
			custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_ARTIST_NOT_BUSY_TT
			NOT = { has_character_modifier = busy_modifier }
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_CHARACTER_NOT_ALREADY_TV_IO_CHIEF_TT
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_io_chief_role }
			}
			is_ruler = no
			is_heir = no
			is_consort = no
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:target }
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = tv_arts_exhibition_leader_char }
					var:tv_arts_exhibition_leader_char ?= {
						remove_variable = tv_io_chief_role
						remove_character_modifier = tv_chief_artist_role_modifier
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_arts_exhibition_leader_char value = scope:target }
			}
			scope:target = {
				set_variable = { name = tv_io_chief_role value = 1 }
				add_character_modifier = { modifier = tv_chief_artist_role_modifier years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Academy of Sciences (non-unique IO)
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

tv_appoint_academy_leader = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 99999

	potential = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = TV_HAS_ACADEMY_IO_MEMBER_TT
			scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_academy_io_member }
		}
	}

	allow = { always = yes }

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = character
		source = actor
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_select_academy_leader"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_no_academy_leader_available"
		column = { data = character_info }
		visible = {
			is_alive = yes
			is_adult = yes
			NOT = { is_artist = yes }
			OR = {
			is_female = no
			scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_academy_of_sciences
			leader_country ?= scope:actor
			international_organization_has_policy = policy:tv_academy_leader_gender_unrestricted_policy
			}
			}
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_CHARACTER_NOT_ALREADY_TV_IO_CHIEF_TT
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_io_chief_role }
			}
			is_ruler = no
			is_heir = no
			is_consort = no
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:target }
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = tv_academy_leader_char }
					var:tv_academy_leader_char ?= {
						remove_variable = tv_io_chief_role
						remove_character_modifier = tv_chief_scientist_role_modifier
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_academy_leader_char value = scope:target }
				tv_update_chief_scientist_effective_adm_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = tv_med_disp_adm value = var:tv_scientist_effective_adm }
				set_variable = { name = tv_med_disp_dip value = var:tv_academy_leader_char.dip }
				set_variable = { name = tv_med_disp_mil value = var:tv_academy_leader_char.mil }
			}
			scope:target = {
				set_variable = { name = tv_io_chief_role value = 1 }
				add_character_modifier = { modifier = tv_chief_scientist_role_modifier years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_remove_academy_leader = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 99999

	potential = {

				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_scientist_effective_adm value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_med_disp_adm value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_med_disp_dip value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_med_disp_mil value = 0 }
			remove_variable = tv_academy_leader_char
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

		visible = {
			is_alive = yes
			is_adult = yes
			is_female = no
			is_artist = no
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_CHARACTER_NOT_ALREADY_TV_IO_CHIEF_TT
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_io_chief_role }
			}
			is_ruler = no
			is_heir = no
			is_consort = no
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = tv_conquest_general_char }
				var:tv_conquest_general_char ?= {
					remove_variable = tv_io_chief_role
					remove_character_modifier = tv_grand_general_role_modifier
				}
			}
			tv_govhouse_pay_grand_general_replacement_cost_effect = yes
			remove_variable = tv_gg_loyalty_value
			hidden_effect = {
			  tv_training_clear_effect = yes
			  tv_govhouse_clear_war_tent_effect = yes
			  tv_govhouse_reset_power_consolidation_effect = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:target }
			scope:actor = {
				set_variable = { name = tv_conquest_general_char value = scope:target }
				tv_govhouse_on_grand_general_appointed_effect = yes
			}
			scope:target = {
				set_variable = { name = tv_io_chief_role value = 1 }
				add_character_modifier = { modifier = tv_grand_general_role_modifier years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}
